text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple developed body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It presents its argument in a clearer essay structure with an introduction, several body points, and a conclusion that are easy to follow."},{"evidence":"safety, benefits, and environment points","quality":"development","description":"It explores more than one concern and explains them with fuller reasoning rather than relying on a few brief claims."},{"evidence":"“it should depend on how many tests they've taken” and “if the driverless car was had a negative impact”","quality":"elaboration","description":"It adds explanatory comments and follow-up discussion that extend its points beyond simple assertions."},{"evidence":"“First,” “Secondly,” “Also,” “Lastly”","quality":"transitions","description":"It uses more explicit connecting words to guide the reader through its argument."},{"evidence":"“I would want to oppose the development of driverless cars”","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states its position more clearly and consistently, making the writer’s overall view easier to identify."}]}
